voiceover_script: Markandey rishivar ko varan tha — sirf 16 saal ki umra. Uske paida hote hi maa-baap ne Shiv ki bhakti mein laga diya. 16 saal par Yama aaya apne paash lekar. description:
Mahadev Ne Yama Se Chheen Li Markandey Ki Zindagi! ⚡

🔱 Markandey Shiva devotee Yama kicked death conquered

Sage Markandeya was destined to die at 16. On his deathday, he clung to a Shivalinga praying. Yama (Death) arrived and threw his noose. The noose touched the linga. Shiva emerged furiously and kicked Yama, warning: 'Whoever surrenders to me is beyond your reach.' Markandeya became immortal.
